Cyber Ready at Every Stage of Your Security Journey
																		
Sygnia’s holistic, end-to-end solution set spans proactive and reactive cyber security. From executive-level strategic guidance to on-the-ground technical expertise, our incident response-fueled services enable our clients to be cyber ready in times of crisis and calm.

Services
                    
                                                    

                        

                            
The actions taken in the first 24 hours following a breach determine whether it is a cyber incident or a full-blown crisis. This truth drives our urgency to ensure our clients are cyber ready in times of crisis and calm. We are by their side to contain attacks at top speed and recover with as little business impact as possible. And we help them prepare for the threats that lie ahead, so their business is ready for anything that comes their way.

Enterprise Solutions
                
                                        

                    

                        
As the trusted advisor and cybersecurity service provider of leading organizations worldwide, Sygnia protects the enterprise through a variety of solutions that are aligned with the current threat landscape. From OT and Cloud Security to Ransomware Readiness, our Enterprise Solutions are borne out of frontline experience and a deep understanding of the threat actor mindset.
                    
                
                    
        

            

                

                                                                                                    
                                

                                    

                                        
                                    
                                                                            

                                            

                                        
                                                                    
                                

                                    

                                                                                                                            

                                                
Cloud Security
                                            
                                                                                                                            

                                                
Expanding cloud footprint can lead to expanding security gaps. With more infrastructure and workloads migrating to the cloud, it is essential that cyber resilience is enhanced rather than compromised. Sygnia offers a suite of services designed and proven to enhance cloud cyber resilience.

OT Security
                                            
                                                                                                                            

                                                
The industrial sector has become one of the most targeted globally, with increased risk to operational business continuity, reliability and safety. Sygnia’s holistic OT security offering has been designed to achieve complete enterprise-wide cybersecurity.

Technology
                    
                                                    

                        

                            
Sygnia’s teams draw on deep technical expertise to work effectively with any IT or security stack, in any domain including cloud, application, CI/CD, OT, mobile, IoT, and traditional network infrastructure. We also offer bespoke, proprietary technology solutions for more advanced security needs through our Velocity TDIR.
                        
                    
                            
            

                

                                            

                            

                                                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                            
                                        
                                    
                                                                

                                    

                                                                                    

                                                
Velocity TDIR
                                            
                                                                                                                            

                                                

                                                    
Velocity TDIR is a unified security detection and response platform designed for contextualizing and understanding masses of alerts that arrive from multiple, siloed systems. This proprietary technology offers unmatched speed of forensic collection, detection, triage, analysis and mitigation.
